name: Mayonnaise
body:
Station and Complexity line cook 1, roundsman 1

Flavor Profiles sour or texture
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, or spicy

EFFECT

Duration 1 day/level, or 1 round when consumed; Serving Size 1d6
Saving Throw Will negates

DESCRIPTION

Eggs are whipped with an acid (such as lemon juice) until it becomes a spread.

When added to another meal as an additional sour or texture ingredient, it grants a +1 resistance bonus to saving throws against effects that daze, paralyze, or stun for the duration of the meal to which it was added.

When consumed by itself, it causes a non-magical daze monster effect for 1 round.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size and resistance bonus by +1 each and allow the mayonnaise to be used in place of that type of flavor profile as well.
